scope: offline fixed-reference replay of the additive-boss-dependent-cut-v1 canonical sequence

intermediate_contract.verified_prefix: after-boss.step must pass its frozen one-solid, base-extent and boss-height checks before any suffix treatment.
intermediate_contract.final_authority: Existing output readability, bbox, volume and topology gates remain authoritative for after-cut.step.

treatments.baseline: Run the full fixed reference sequence and retain all three intermediate artifacts.
treatments.injected_mid_sequence_defect: Replace only the sketch_cut/cut suffix with a preregistered invalid cut-depth operation after after-boss.step is written; record the first failing boundary without modifying after-boss.step.
treatments.rollback: Reuse byte-identical after-boss.step, regenerate only sketch_cut/cut with the canonical suffix, and compare prefix hash and final gates to baseline.
treatments.non_matching_control: Inject a defect before the boss artifact. The result must be unsupported for rollback and must not claim a verified prefix.

acceptance: Every retained artifact has a SHA-256 and a step index.
The injected defect fails after a verified prefix and leaves its prefix hash unchanged.
Rollback reuses the byte-identical prefix and restores the baseline final gate results.
The non-matching control is rejected before rollback.
stopping_rule: No source patch, provider call or automatic runtime rollback.
No public Harness schema, gate, manifest, parser, helper, IR or SDK change.
If a reproducible prefix artifact cannot be retained and verified, record no reusable rollback evidence.
